entities.summary: Arnaud d'Aux was a relative of Pope Clement V, who named him bishop of Poitiers, and then cardinal-bishop of Albano. He accompanied cardinal Arnaud Nouvel in England in 1312. He acted also as Camerlengo of the Holy Roman Church from 1311 until 1319. He participated in the papal conclave, 1314-1316 and died at Avignon.
